definitions: The action of lightly touching something with a dabber or an absorbent material.
A dance move involving the dropping of one's head and raising an arm, with the elbow bent, to one side, resembling a sneeze.
The act of applying a small amount of a substance, typically a drug, to a surface or directly to the body.
examples: The dabbing of the paint created a textured finish.
The crowd cheered for his impressive dabbing.
He was caught dabbing the substance onto his skin.
